newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's February coffee output jumps to 747 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Peru's February coffee output jumps to 747 tonnes.

text.p: Peru's February coffee production rose to 747 tonnes from 263 tonnes in the same month last year, Agriculture Ministry said Monday.
Production in the first two months of the year rose to 762 tonnes from 325 tonnes in the same period last year, the ministry added in its monthly report.
Non-decaffeinated coffee exports fell 72.8 percent in January to $3.19 million compared with the same month last year, the ministry said.
The ministry did not give export figures for January.
Peru, whose principal coffee harvest is between April and November, is South America's number four producer after Brazil, Colombia and Ecuador, according to the government.
